# Node and edge kinds

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_kinds.py from code_review_graph/kinds.py. Do not edit. -->

Edges are stored as `source -> target`. `direction` says how impact
propagates: `incoming` walks from a changed target back to its sources,
`outgoing` from a changed source to its targets, `none` is not traversed.
`-` means the default (incoming direction, weight 0.5 for impact;
community default for clustering).

## Edge kinds

| Kind | Direction | Impact weight | Community weight | Dependents | Cross-stack | Risk callers | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALLS` | incoming | 1.0 | 1.0 | yes |  | yes |  | Caller invokes callee |
| `INHERITS` | incoming | 0.9 | 0.8 | yes |  |  |  | Subtype extends supertype |
| `OVERRIDES` | incoming | 0.9 | - |  |  |  |  | Method overrides a supertype method |
| `IMPLEMENTS` | incoming | 0.9 | 0.7 | yes |  |  |  | Class implements an interface |
| `TESTED_BY` | outgoing | 0.7 | 0.4 |  |  |  |  | Production code -> the test covering it |
| `REFERENCES` | incoming | 0.6 | - |  |  |  |  | Symbol mentions another symbol |
| `DEPENDS_ON` | incoming | 0.6 | 0.6 |  |  |  |  | Generic dependency |
| `IMPORTS_FROM` | incoming | 0.5 | 0.5 | yes |  |  |  | Module imports from another module |
| `RENDERS` | incoming | 0.6 | - |  | yes |  |  | Page renders a server class (useActionBean, bean binding) |
| `REQUESTS` | incoming | 0.5 | - |  | yes |  |  | Page script requests a server route |
| `INCLUDES` | incoming | 0.5 | - |  | yes |  |  | Page includes another page or script file |
| `CONTAINS` | none | 0.3 | 0.3 |  |  |  |  | Parent contains child |
| `INJECTS` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Dependency injection point |
| `HANDLES` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Handler serves an endpoint |
| `TRIGGERS` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Scheduler triggers a job |
| `PUBLISHES` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Code publishes an event |
| `CONSUMES` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Code consumes a message |
| `PRODUCES` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Code produces a message |
| `TEMPORAL_STUB` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Unresolved Temporal workflow/activity stub |
| `DEPENDS_ON_CONFIG` | - | - | - |  |  |  |  | Code reads a configuration key |
| `FORWARDS_TO` | incoming | 0.6 | - |  | yes |  | fs.6 | Action forwards or redirects to a page |
| `BINDS` | incoming | 0.5 | - |  | yes |  | fs.6 | Form field binds to a bean property |
| `USES_STYLE` | incoming | 0.4 | - |  | yes |  | fs.6 | Page uses a stylesheet class selector |
| `MAPS_TO` | incoming | 0.6 | - |  | yes |  | fs.6 | Entity or mapping file maps to a database table |

## Node kinds

| Kind | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `File` |  | A source file |
| `Class` |  | Class, interface, struct, enum or record |
| `Function` |  | Function, method or constructor |
| `Type` |  | Type alias or type declaration |
| `Test` |  | Test function |
| `Endpoint` |  | HTTP route exposed by a handler |
| `ConfigProperty` |  | Configuration key |
| `Scheduler` |  | Scheduled job trigger |
| `Event` |  | Application event published or handled |
| `Table` | fs.6 | Database table of an ORM mapping |
